name: Forced displacement
summary: No new event displacing 500,000 in a month; Sudan's long-running crisis remains the largest
state: No single new event displacing more than 500,000 people in a month had been found as of 7 Nov. Sudan remains the world's largest displacement crisis, with millions displaced inside the country and abroad (UNHCR; IOM via VOA). That is a long-running crisis rather than a new event.
for_you: No direct risk to most readers; UN agencies are appealing for funding.
basis_detail: UNHCR, IOM DTM and IDMC figures
basis_by: UNHCR, IOM DTM and IDMC figures

sources.title: VOA — IOM: Sudan's displacement crisis worsening

why: Over 120 million people are forcibly displaced; new mass displacement drives regional instability and migration politics.
